title: Mighty V Passage
heading: Our smallest rig opened the largest door.
summary: Spencer proposed a national-park trip from Denver to Las Vegas. We trusted Mighty V and discovered that the drive itself could become the trip.
alt: Cassie, David and Spencer beneath Delicate Arch
dek: Our smallest rig opened the largest door.

title: Northwest Hot-lap
heading: The Pacific Coast demands our attention.
summary: The four of us followed U.S. 101 through rainforest, mist, and hundreds of miles beside an angry ocean.
dek: The Pacific Coast demands our attention.

title: Great Western Loop
heading: Practice makes perfect, NOT!
summary: Sleeping in a car began as an experiment. Six weeks across the West proved the bed, the cooler, the camps, and our willingness to let the road rewrite the plan.
alt: Bisti Badlands on the Great Western Loop
dek: The West is too big for a straight line.

title: Pacific Coast Highway Expedition
heading: Keep the ocean on the right!
summary: We took Ivan to the Pacific, followed California Highway 1 south, and completed our first coast-to-coast drive from Los Angeles to Miami.
dek: An ultimate road trip — keep the ocean on the right!

title: Southern Colorado Expedition
heading: PourHouse makes its debut on the road.
summary: A birthday invitation became PourHouse’s first long-distance expedition—and a full-scale test across southern Colorado’s scenic roads and high country.
alt: PourHouse, the Sprinter, on a mountain road
dek: PourHouse makes its debut on the road.

title: California Expedition
heading: PourHouse becomes a full-time travel rig.
summary: We traveled west for Thanksgiving, lived along the California coast, wandered east through the desert, and proved PourHouse as our full-time platform.
dek: PourHouse graduates to a full-time travel rig.
